title: Build concept screen first; operator promotes to production
summary: When migrating a screen toward a concept/reference plate, add a separate *ConceptView (or concept launch arg) first. Do not replace the production screen until the operator compares capture vs reference and explicitly approves promotion.
rationale: Operator rejected direct production edits during Meet/Circles migration (Jul 9). Agents claimed parity without operator sign-off. Concept-first keeps production stable and makes approval explicit.
task: Migrate native screens toward concept mockups
situation: Agents replaced production views directly and declared done before operator review.
evidence: Cursor prompt 2026-07-09: separate screen until operator confirms
